metadata.description: Supported normalized metadata keys have string values, preserving observed text without asserting valid timestamps or identifiers. All keys are optional; M0/M1 text parsing emits {}. Additional keys or value types require an explicit schema update.

structure.description: No structure before parsing, or the complete text-source structure contract.

finding.description: A stable rule ID selects exactly one nested evidence and location contract. The enclosing object requires all common fields and forbids unknown keys. New detector IDs/shapes require a schema update; there is no unconstrained fallback.
